issues.problem: The narration says 'Có {n} lá và n − 1 nút trong' / 'There are {n} leaves and n − 1 inner nodes'. For a segment tree built on an arbitrary n (not a power of two), the number of inner nodes is not always n−1 if the tree is not a full binary tree. However, the standard recursive segment tree always has exactly n leaves and n−1 inner nodes because it is a full binary tree (every internal node has exactly 2 children). So this is correct.

The claim 'Một truy vấn thăm tối đa khoảng 4·log₂ n nút' / 'A query visits at most about 4·log₂ n nodes' is a standard upper bound, but the exact bound is 4·log₂ n + 1 or similar. The word 'khoảng' / 'about' makes it acceptable.
